channel.title: Fintech News Hong Kong - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fintech News Hong Kong (fintechnews.hk)

item.title: SBI VC Trade Launches USDC Lending Service for Retail Investors in Japan - Fintech Hong Kong
item.description: SBI VC Trade launches USDC lending in Japan, offering up to 10% yield with a 12-week term and capped participation.

item.title: China Adds 12 Banks to Digital Yuan Network as Adoption Push Continues - Fintech Hong Kong
item.description: China plans to add 12 banks to its digital yuan network, as Beijing seeks to expand e-CNY use domestically and in cross-border payments.

item.title: Huawei Smartwatches Now Accept Instant SEPA Payments with Yowpay - Fintech Hong Kong
item.description: Huawei and Yowpay launch the world’s first SEPA smartwatch POS, enabling instant payments directly on Huawei watches.

item.title: Adyen Expands Direct Acquiring for Cathay Pacific Across 6 Key Markets - Fintech Hong Kong
item.description: Adyen expands direct acquiring with Cathay Pacific across six markets, including India, boosting payment authorisation rates.

item.title: Grab Expands into Taiwan with US$600 Million Acquisition of foodpanda - Fintech Hong Kong
item.description: Grab will acquire foodpanda Taiwan for US$600 million, marking its first expansion outside Southeast Asia and targeting 21 cities by 2027.

item.title: Naver to Deploy AI Agents Across All Services, Targets Productivity Gains - Fintech Hong Kong
item.description: Naver plans to roll out AI agents across all services, including shopping and search, aiming to double productivity in 2026.

item.title: Building Trust in Digital Asset Infrastructure with Hardware Roots of Trust
item.description: Richard Chiu of Thales highlights that true Security for any Digital Asset relies on protecting private keys within tamper-resistant hardware

item.title: Mox Bank Acquires US$1 Billion Personal Loan Portfolio from Standard Chartered - Fintech Hong Kong
item.description: Mox Bank acquires a US$1b personal loan portfolio from Standard Chartered Hong Kong, aiming to break even and boost its loan book in H1 2026.
